LESSON: GUIDED READING

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Reading 2.7 Guided Reading (2 lessons) • Vocabulary development • Fluency By the
Topic 2.9: Guided Reading
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Reading, part of Reading 2.7 Guided Reading (2 lessons) • Vocabulary development • Fluency By the in Grade 6 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: What strategies can one apply to ensure comprehension of texts?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read a text and list down the school facilities mentioned (图书馆、教 室、体育馆、操场、办公室、餐 厅),

2. highlight words related to school facilities from a crossword puzzle and read them out,

3. read out the location of various facilities on a school map using location words (方位词: 旁边、对 面、前面、后面),

4. read a text describing the location of different items, people and facilities in the school then answer the questions,

5. match pictures of their school facilities with the correct descriptions collaboratively,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read a text and list down the school facilities mentioned (图书馆、教 室、体育馆、操场、办公室、餐 厅),
2. highlight words related to school facilities from a crossword puzzle and read them out,
3. read out the location of various facilities on a school map using location words (方位词: 旁边、对 面、前面、后面),
4. read a text describing the location of different items, people and facilities in the school then answer the questions,
5. match pictures of their school facilities with the correct descriptions collaboratively,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Reading together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Critical thinking and Problem solving: The learner develops researching skills as they seek information from peers on how to

overcome challenges in utilising the various reading strategies.

Values:
Peace is promoted when the learner displays calmness as they collaboratively match pictures of school facilities with the correct

descriptions.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Peer education and Mentorship: These are promoted as the learner collaborates with peers to propose feasible solutions to their

problems in applying reading strategies appropriately.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner relates the concept of giving the position and location of places to Social Studies.
